# tunnel

<!-- Generated by nightseam from nightseam:tunnel/; do not edit. -->

A family of the `nightseam.duplex/1` profile, declared in `nightseam:tunnel/model.json`, `nightseam:tunnel/protocol.json`.
The tiers it declares bring the built-in family `duplex`, imported implicitly.

## Types

### Close

A record. The close of a channel, travelling in order behind the frames sent before it.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | `integer` | required | — |  |
| `code` | `integer` | required | — |  |
| `reason` | `string` | optional | — |  |

### Credit

A record. Credit the receiver returns for frames its consumer took.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | `integer` | required | — |  |
| `frames` | `integer` | required | — |  |

### Frame

A record. One inner frame on a channel: exactly one of text and binary, a binary frame base64.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | `integer` | required | — |  |
| `text` | `string` | optional | — |  |
| `binary` | `string` | optional | — |  |

### Open

A record. What the side that opens a channel asks for.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | `integer` | required | — | The id the opener chose: odd for the client of the outer connection, even for its server. |
| `family` | `string` | required | — | The family the channel will speak. |
| `after` | `integer` | optional | — | The last sequence the opener holds, carried and never acted on. |
| `window` | `integer` | required | — | How many frames the opener will hold in flight before it returns credit. |

### Opened

A record. What the accepting side answers an open with.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | `integer` | required | — | The accepting side's window. |

## Carried types

These are this family's own types, declared in the same language by a built-in family Nightseam declares of itself and imported by the tier that brings it, with no `imports` line. A declaration of this family may not declare one and names it by the built-in that declares it — `duplex.Envelope`.

### Envelope

A record, carried from the built-in `duplex` family. One message of the nightseam.duplex/1 profile: the members the peer acts on, and nothing else.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `integer` | required | — | The profile's version, 1. |
| `kind` | `string` | required | — | request, response, event or cancel. |
| `id` | `string` | optional | — | What correlates a response or a cancel with its request. |
| `method` | `string` | optional | — | The method a request names. |
| `params` | `json` | optional | — | A request's parameters. |
| `result` | `json` | optional | — | A response's result. |
| `error` | `json` | optional | — | A response's error. |
| `event` | `string` | optional | — | The event an event frame names. |
| `data` | `json` | optional | — | An event's data. |
| `traceparent` | `string` | optional | — | The W3C Trace Context of the frame. |
| `tracestate` | `string` | optional | — | The vendor state of that trace. |
| `meta` | map of `string` | optional | — | What a request or an event carries about the call, delivered to the handler beside the payload. |

### Handle

A record, carried from the built-in `duplex` family. A reference to a channel on the connection that carries the message holding it.

| Field | Type | Presence | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | `integer` | required | — | The channel's id on that connection. |

## Server side

The server implements these methods and emits these events.

| Method | Request | Result | Errors | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel.open` | `Open` | `Opened` | `channel_invalid`, `channel_exists`, `channel_refused` | Opens a channel that speaks a family. |

| Event | Data | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `channel.close` | `Close` | The close of a channel. |
| `channel.credit` | `Credit` | Credit returned for frames taken. |
| `channel.frame` | `Frame` | One inner frame, opaque to the tunnel. |

## Client side

The client implements these methods, which the server calls, and emits these events.

| Method | Request | Result | Errors | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel.open` | `Open` | `Opened` | `channel_invalid`, `channel_exists`, `channel_refused` | Opens a channel that speaks a family; either side may open. |

| Event | Data | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `channel.close` | `Close` | The close of a channel. |
| `channel.credit` | `Credit` | Credit returned for frames taken. |
| `channel.frame` | `Frame` | One inner frame, opaque to the tunnel. |

## Errors

The public errors of the family, by code: what a call may fail with.

| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| `channel_exists` | The id is open. |
| `channel_invalid` | The open is malformed, or names an id of the accepting side's parity. |
| `channel_refused` | Nobody here has taken the channels already opened, up to the accept capacity. |
